Source_assets and protected_layouts are empty, so no source opens or protected-layout reads were applicable. Actually opened and visually inspected all fifteen exact poster views through tools.view_image with detail original, forwarding the returned images at original detail: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then M2 in that order; M3 in that order; M4 in that order; M5 in that order. Completed those fifteen initial views before starting first copy readings, judgments or scores. First raw readings were retained in session memory after the fifteen views. Then opened M1 native once and M4 native once, solely for the respective date/hour range-stroke ambiguities, preserving first and revisit readings. No crop, OCR, substitute image, image edit, inferred native opening/session ID or helper-based claim of viewing. Embedded source/call-input/pre-call/final paths in the manifests were not followed.
